lighting.title: Local lighting control
lighting.description: Chandelier: 1–4 groups in turn-off order. Kitchen: all 4 groups, cycle 0000 → 1000 → 1100 → 1110 → 0010 → 0001 → 0000. Every press refreshes the selection window. New processes start disabled; saving options resets selection without switching lights. Chandelier mode also creates one light with discrete brightness steps and saved group combinations.

data.name: Process name
data.night_light: Night light (light or switch) — toggle with HOLD

motion.title: Motion lighting
motion.description: Any active motion sensor turns the light on. All sensors must remain off for the off delay. Unavailable sensors do not prove absence.

shared_fan.title: Shared extraction
shared_fan.description: Room lights request delayed extraction. Any selected fan requests immediate extraction. Run-on starts when all inputs are off. Only this process commands the shared output.

humidity.title: Humidity ventilation
humidity.description: Rising humidity with the room light on starts the bathroom fan. Sustained falling humidity keeps it running. A confirmed plateau ends the cycle even with the light on. The fallback does not limit useful drying. Configure shared extraction as a separate process.

data.name: Process name
data.rising_slope: Rising threshold (RH percentage points per minute)
data.falling_slope: Falling threshold (negative RH percentage points per minute)
data.stable_slope: Plateau slope tolerance (RH percentage points per minute)
data.uncertain_timeout_minutes: Fallback wait without a clear trend (minutes)

hood.title: Kitchen hood
hood.description: Four relays of one M3000-BB-1020 via Modbus Devices 1.9.0. Home Control requests a device read before switching. Configure all four panel inputs or none. Saved speed is used only on turn-on. New processes start disabled.

doorbell.title: Doorbell
doorbell.description: Starts disabled. The native Ring button obeys the schedule. Fill only fields for your selected source. Volume is restored after the configured duration; music is not resumed.

data.name: Name
data.mqtt_key: JSON field path (e.g. Button1.Action); empty for plain payload

doorbell_night.title: Quiet interval
doorbell_night.description: Use whole minutes. Weekdays refer to the start date. To edit, remove the old interval and add a new one. Overlaps are rejected.
